title: All four quant panels ship hardcoded valuation/expiry dates that are already in the past (2026-05-16 / 2026-06-30)
subsystem: quant panels (option pricer, greeks, bond, yield curve)
repro: Open Option Pricer today (2026-09-19) -> prefilled Valuation 2026-05-16, Expiry 2026-06-30; the empty-state CTA 'prices with the prefilled inputs', i.e. an option that expired 81 days ago as of a date 4 months stale. Same literal in Greeks, Bond, Yield-curve.
notes: Defaults frozen at the day the panel was written; every day after, the prefilled example is a past-dated contract and theta/time-value the user reads is for a period that no longer exists. Fix shape: derive defaults at mount (today, today+45d; bond issue=today, maturity=today+10y) in one shared helper.
